description: This file is a React component for a career navigation feature called 'Multiverse'. It renders a complex UI including a multiverse map with path nodes, filters, role details, and role cart. It manages state related to selected nodes, filters, and the role cart, and includes data definitions for nodes representing different career paths.

methods.name: isNodeInFilters
methods.description: Determines if a node matches the current filters based on path type, industry, and timeline constraints.

methods.name: useLocalStorageSet
methods.description: Custom React hook for managing a Set stored in localStorage, with automatic synchronization.

methods.name: IconCart
methods.description: React component rendering a shopping cart icon SVG.

methods.name: ProgressRing
methods.description: React component rendering a circular progress indicator with percentage value.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into an array of strings, safe from errors.

methods.name: MultiverseStepPage
methods.description: Main React component for the Career Multiverse page, encompassing map visualization, filters, role details, and role cart management.
